title: What the recordings paid
summary: They were paid $15 a side; royalties went to the song owners.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Well, to get back once more, we won't bother about the records anymore. Do you remember though, what they paid? Did they pay so much aside, or so much to date? They didn't have a union, I don't think much in those days, any regular scale for making records. About what did they pay? I'm not trying to put into your business.
Well, that's alright. They paid us $15 a side for the record, a piece. And the royalty, well, the man who had the songs- The composers of the royalty. Yeah, well, he got it.
